_notes.forbidden_allergens: GS1 allergen codes, e.g. AN tree nuts, AP peanuts, SA almond, SH hazelnut, AS sesame, AM milk, ML lactose, AW gluten
_notes.allergen_policy: may_contain and no_data: block | needs_approval | allow. Missing data is unknown, never allergen-free.
_notes.substitutions: allowed | with_approval | forbidden. Official substitutes must also be the same product category (fit check).
_notes.weights: Ranking only. Unknown delivery reliability is neutral (0.95) and shown as a flag instead.
